$comment: Cochilo's own tokens (design/product/cochilo/README.md): the core tokens it pulls with "@", plus what only Cochilo has (kind colours, the Log button, the night light, sleep's bigger round…), and the contrast pairs it must pass in all three themes.

layer.$comment: Cochilo, the baby sleep tracker (gabrielbr/Cochilo), Jetpack Compose (br.gabriel.cochilo.ui.theme). Light and dark. Type roles, sizes and spacing copy uikit, so the Compose kit reads like the Views kit (the D-1 direction of travel). Fairy mode is not carried: Cochilo's profile is the baby, not the person holding the phone (D-12). Dressed as a Tatá Slings product (brands.tata-slings, docs/brands.md). From 0.7.0 its data colours are her fabrics, each kind's icon sits in a soft round of its colour, and its corners are rounder (docs/brands.md, "Tecidos").

color.name: panel
color.usage: The sleep panel while the baby sleeps: a dark block, so the screen gets dimmer, not brighter, at night.

color.name: on-panel
color.usage: Text and the timer on panel.

color.name: on-panel-muted
color.usage: Secondary text on panel.

color.name: snackbar
color.usage: Snackbar ground; its text is page, its action is snackbar-action.

color.name: snackbar-action
color.usage: The snackbar's action, same values as uikit's: mint on the dark light-theme ground, deep mint on the light dark-theme ground (4.8:1).

color.name: fab
color.usage: The Log button, the main action in the thumb's corner on every tab. Not the screen's one accent action (that stays mint): a second, quieter fill. Its icon is on-fab.

color.name: on-fab
color.usage: The plus on the Log button, and text on a highlighted Log menu row.

color.name: selected
color.usage: What is picked in a set that isn't an action: the active tab's pill, a picked filter chip. Under the brand a soft blush, so teal stays the one action (0.11.0).

color.name: on-selected
color.usage: Icon and text on selected.

color.name: frame-line
color.usage: The frame round the screen. Under the brand a soft blush edge, like a fabric hem, not a teal rule (0.11.0).

color.name: event-night
color.usage: Data: night sleep. Lavanda, one of her fabrics. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-nap
color.usage: Data: naps. Imensidão blue, so a nap and a night are told apart by hue as well as by the word. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-feed
color.usage: Data: feeds (breast, bottle, solids). Rosa Chá, deepened to be seen. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-pump
color.usage: Data: pumping sessions. Amora. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-diaper
color.usage: Data: diaper changes. Trevo. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-daylight
color.usage: Data: time outdoors in daylight. Mel. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-routine
color.usage: Data: routines (bath, bedtime). Turquesa, the brand teal deepened. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-medicine
color.usage: Data: medicine. Cereja. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-note
color.usage: Data: notes. Capuccino. On the timeline, the charts and as the line of its kind's icon. Always beside a word.

color.name: event-night-soft
color.usage: The round behind the night icon (a soft tint of event-night). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-nap-soft
color.usage: The round behind the nap icon (a soft tint of event-nap). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-feed-soft
color.usage: The round behind the feed icon (a soft tint of event-feed). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-pump-soft
color.usage: The round behind the pump icon (a soft tint of event-pump). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-diaper-soft
color.usage: The round behind the diaper icon (a soft tint of event-diaper). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-daylight-soft
color.usage: The round behind the daylight icon (a soft tint of event-daylight). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-routine-soft
color.usage: The round behind the routine icon (a soft tint of event-routine). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-medicine-soft
color.usage: The round behind the medicine icon (a soft tint of event-medicine). Never text, never alone.

color.name: event-note-soft
color.usage: The round behind the note icon (a soft tint of event-note). Never text, never alone.

color.name: illustration-skin-1
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Skin tone 1, the lightest. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Skin tone 2. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-skin-6
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Skin tone 6, the deepest. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-hair-black
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Hair: black. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-hair-brown
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Hair: brown. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-hair-blond
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Hair: blond. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-hair-red
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Hair: red. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-catchlight
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar): the small light in an open eye, so the eyes read on every skin tone. The same in both themes.

color.name: illustration-cheek
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): The cheeks' blush. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-face-line
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Eyes, mouth and the drawing's line, on any skin tone. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-wrap
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): The Rosa Chá sling the baby is wrapped in. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-wrap-edge
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): The sling's folds. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

color.name: illustration-bow
color.usage: Illustration (the baby avatar, docs/components.md): Amora: the bow, when the parent chose “girl”. The same in both themes: a baby doesn't change colour at night. Never UI state, never text.

radius.name: radius-s
radius.usage: Buttons, chips, fields, the monogram: the system's radius-m, so Cochilo is soft like fabric (0.7.0).

radius.name: radius-m
radius.usage: Cards and the sleep panel: the system's radius-l.

size.name: monogram
size.usage: The CO_ mark in the header.

size.name: row-min
size.usage: Minimum row height: a one-handed tap at 3am.

size.name: timeline
size.usage: Height of the 24-hour timeline bar and of one day in the actogram.

size.name: kind-badge
size.usage: The round of colour behind an entry kind's icon (the icon stays 22dp inside).

size.name: kind-badge-lead
size.usage: Sleep's round, a size up from kind-badge: sleep is what Cochilo is for, so it leads every list, menu and timeline (0.9.0).

size.name: outline
size.usage: A strong outline: the option used last time (in its kind's colour) and the picked fabric swatch.

size.name: avatar
size.usage: The baby avatar where it is the subject (onboarding, the look picker, the empty Today, celebrations).

size.name: rail
size.usage: Navigation rail width: the tab bar stands on its side from the medium width (0.21.0).

size.name: content-max
size.usage: The widest a screen's column grows on a tablet or an unfolded phone, so lines stay readable and the thumb's reach is kept.

size.name: width-medium
size.usage: Window width from which the rail replaces the tab bar (Android's medium window class).

size.name: width-expanded
size.usage: Window width from which Today and a second tab sit side by side (Android's expanded window class).

motion.name: motion-stagger
motion.usage: The delay between one item and the next when a list opens in a cascade (the Log menu), nearest the finger first. Each item still moves for motion-emphasised; snaps with Remove animations.

motion.name: motion-breathe
motion.usage: One slow breath, in or out: the next expected sleep on the day ring fades between full and soft so the eye finds it (0.59.0). The only looping motion; still at full with Remove animations.
